outcome: admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
interventions due to fetal distress during labor (IDFD, including vaginal-operative delivery or emergency caesarean section)
cohort: The study included 491 singleton pregnancies with appropriately grown fetuses (AGA) and intended vaginal deliveries.
finding: A reduced cerebro-placental ratio (CPR) below 1.269 at 40+0 weeks' gestation significantly increased the risk of adverse perinatal outcomes, including NICU admissions and interventions due to fetal distress during labor.
mod_finding: Interventions due to fetal distress, encompassing vaginal-operative delivery or emergency caesarean section, significantly increased when the CPR was below 1.269.
